```{r set}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r gen}
n <- 1000
alpha <- 40
beta <- 50
sigma <- 0.1
dbh <- runif(n, 1, 200)
h <- (alpha * dbh/(beta+dbh))*exp(rnorm(n, sd = sigma))
data <- tibble(dbh, h)
ggplot(data, aes(dbh, h)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) alpha*x/(beta+x)) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
data$error <- data$h - alpha * dbh/(beta+dbh)
sde <- sd(data$error)
ggplot(data, aes(error)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-sde, sde), linetype = "dashed")
```

```{r}
dbh_new <- runif(n, 1, 200)
h_new <- (alpha * dbh/(beta+dbh))*exp(rnorm(n, sd = sqrt(sde)))
data_new <- tibble(dbh_new, h_new)
ggplot(data, aes(dbh_new, h_new)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_function(fun = function(x) alpha*x/(beta+x)) +
  theme_bw()
```
